decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility 3634 point with the planar centroid of the City of Kansas City, Missouri parcel at 1325 Tracy Ave, where the city's business-licence register lists Patmos Hosting Inc as a data-processing and web-hosting business.
computation: The parcel ring (EPSG:4326 as published by the Socrata API) was projected to NAD83(HARN) / Missouri West (EPSG:2817) with pyproj 3.7.1, its planar centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1 and transformed back to WGS84: [-94.56726182780503, 39.09720330967427], rounded to 7 decimals.

business_licence_point.note: Geocoded location column of the licence dataset (geocoder not stated); identity only, not used as the locator.

identity_bridge: Patmos's status page names the affected KC1 site 'Kansas City 1 (Tracy Ave)'; Kansas City's business-licence register lists PATMOS HOSTING INC (computing infrastructure, data processing and web hosting) at 1325 TRACY AVE, 64106; KCIX lists Joe's Datacenter, LLC at 1325 Tracy Ave, and Patmos says it acquired Joe's Datacenter in 2023.
